name: openagent-desktop
description: OpenAgent Desktop — Electron wrapper for OpenAgent server + web UI

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,electron -c blue,green "cd ../web && pnpm dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron-vite dev"
scripts.prebuild:deps: pnpm --filter open-agent-server build && pnpm --filter open-agent-web build
scripts.package: pnpm run prebuild:deps && pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:linux: pnpm run prebuild:deps && pnpm run build && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:win: pnpm run prebuild:deps && pnpm run build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:mac: pnpm run prebuild:deps && pnpm run build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml
